feedback.hint: Auto apply after monitoring succeeds; send feedback to AI when it fails.
feedback.hint.compact: Send feedback to AI when it fails.
feedback.hint.default: Auto apply after monitoring succeeds. If it fails, this area will tell you how to send feedback to AI.
feedback.checking: Checking the AI replace content you just copied...
feedback.summary.invalid_block: The copied content is not a complete replace-block format. It may be missing <<<< find, ====, or >>>> replace. Click “Copy Feedback” to ask AI to regenerate strict replace blocks.
feedback.summary.multi_match: Similar code appears multiple times in the current file. Auto mode skipped it to avoid accidental edits. Click “Copy Feedback” to ask AI for more precise replace blocks.
feedback.summary.zero_match: The old code returned by AI was not found in the current file, which means AI used an outdated code version. Click “Copy Feedback” to send the current full code back to AI.
feedback.summary.no_tab: No file is currently open, so auto replace was not executed. Please open a file first.
feedback.summary.default: Auto replace did not succeed this time. Click “Copy Feedback” to send the failure reason and current full code to AI.
feedback.reason.invalid_block: The previous AI response was not a complete replace-block format. Please strictly include `<<<< 文件:`, `<<<< 查找`, `====`, and `>>>> 替换`. Do not output explanations or full files.
feedback.reason.no_tab: No file is currently open, so auto apply cannot run. Please regenerate replace blocks with an opened file context.
feedback.reason.open_failed: The target file path specified by AI does not exist or cannot be opened. Please verify the file path based on the current project structure and correctly provide `<<<< 文件:` before each multi-file block.
feedback.reason.multi_match: The find code matched multiple places in the current file. Auto monitor skipped it to avoid accidental edits. Please add more context so the code under `<<<< 查找` matches only one place.
feedback.reason.zero_match: The find code did not match the current file, which means AI referenced a different code version. Please regenerate replace blocks based on the current full code below. The old code must match exactly.
feedback.reason.partial_failed: Some replacements succeeded and some failed. Please regenerate precise replace blocks only for the failed parts.
feedback.reason.default: Auto replace did not succeed. Please regenerate directly applicable replace blocks based on the current full code below.
